description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pananagammana, Kothmale D/S Division, Nuwaraeliya District - Cad. Map No. 330337
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner information, and land classifications. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category.
